perry-tasks accepts --dry-run silently and WRITES ANYWAY — the flag is not in its help and not implemented, and the PMO used it on intake-write --from-board and asks-write --from-board on 2026-08-30 expecting a preview; both files were really created, 32 and 13 records. An unrecognized flag on a write tool must be a refusal, not a silent write
